scores.question: Which agreements give a party audit rights?

- **Kathy Ireland Endorsement Agreement**: KI, Inc. may inspect and examine Diplomat’s books, records, documents, and materials once each calendar quarter. [AMBASSADOREYEWEARGROUPINC_11_17_1997-EX-10.28-ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT.PDF p. 5]
- **Bizzingo Celebrity Endorsement Agreement**: Theismann may inspect Bizzingo’s books, records, documents, and materials relating to royalties. [BizzingoInc_20120322_8-K_EX-10.17_7504499_EX-10.17_Endorsement Agreement.pdf p. 4]

- **CCA Industries Services Outsourcing Agreement**: CCA and its representatives may inspect and access Emerson’s properties, books, records, agreements, documents, data, files, and personnel. [CCAINDUSTRIESINC_04_14_2014-EX-10.1-OUTSOURCING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 4]
- **N2K-Excite Sponsorship Agreement**: Excite may have an independent CPA inspect Sponsor’s records relating to revenue-sharing payments. [N2KINC_10_16_1997-EX-10.16-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF pp. 5–6]
- **Andy North Endorsement Agreement**: North may inspect Golfers Incorporated’s books and records relating to royalties during the agreement and for two years afterward. [PerformanceSportsBrandsInc_20110909_S-1_EX-10.10_7220214_EX-10.10_Endorsement Agreement.pdf p. 6]

- **AMERICANPHYSICIANSCAPITALINC_03_31_2003-EX-10.26-AGENCY AGREEMENT.PDF**: Section D.1 provides that the reseller agreement’s terms are intended to be no less favorable to Nortel than terms offered to other Entrust resellers, subject to stated qualifications. scores.question: Which agreements are perpetual, with no fixed end date?
scores.answer:
The following agreements have **no fixed end date**, although some end upon specified events:

- **SPARKLINGSPRINGWATERHOLDINGSLTD_07_03_2002-EX-10.13-SOFTWARE LICENSE AND MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT.PDF** — Section 17(a) expressly states that the agreement and license remain effective **perpetually**, provided fees are paid and the agreement is not otherwise terminated. [SPARKLINGSPRINGWATERHOLDINGSLTD_07_03_2002-EX-10.13-SOFTWARE LICENSE AND MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT.PDF p. 5]
- **GarrettMotionInc_20181001_8-K_EX-2.4_11364532_EX-2.4_Intellectual Property Agreement.pdf** — The shared-IP licenses are perpetual; the agreement has no scheduled expiration and, subject to the provisions governing termination before distribution, may terminate only by written agreement of both parties. [GarrettMotionInc_20181001_8-K_EX-2.4_11364532_EX-2.4_Intellectual Property Agreement.pdf pp. 9, 11, 15]
- **AMERICANPHYSICIANSCAPITALINC_03_31_2003-EX-10.26-AGENCY AGREEMENT.PDF** — No fixed term is specified; either party may terminate on at least 120 days’ advance written notice, with additional termination grounds. [AMERICANPHYSICIANSCAPITALINC_03_31_2003-EX-10.26-AGENCY AGREEMENT.PDF pp. 2–3]
- **FEDERATEDGOVERNMENTINCOMESECURITIESINC_04_28_2020-EX-99.SERV AGREE-SERVICES AGREEMENT_POWEROF.pdf** — The power of attorney has no fixed expiration; it ends upon termination of the relevant underlying agreements or written revocation by the Adviser. [FEDERATEDGOVERNMENTINCOMESECURITIESINC_04_28_2020-EX-99.SERV AGREE-SERVICES AGREEMENT_POWEROF.pdf p. 2]
- **MOVADOGROUPINC_04_30_2003-EX-10.28-ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT.PDF** — No fixed expiration is specified; Section 11 provides for termination when the Trust pays the Company the aggregate premiums paid since inception. [MOVADOGROUPINC_04_30_2003-EX-10.28-ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **PREMIERBIOMEDICALINC_05_14_2020-EX-10.2-INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AGREEMENT.PDF** — No fixed agreement term or expiration date is stated, although the licensing terms incorporate the underlying 2010/2020 agreements and provide for reversion upon specified payment failures. [PREMIERBIOMEDICALINC_05_14_2020-EX-10.2-INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AGREEMENT.PDF pp. 2–5]
- **SUNTRONCORP_05_17_2006-EX-10.22-MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT.PDF** — Expressly a continuing agreement, ending upon specified contribution, release, or debt-payment conditions rather than a fixed date, subject to reinstatement provisions. [SUNTRONCORP_05_17_2006-EX-10.22-MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT.PDF pp. 4–5]
